preconditions.description: The root must be a valid TreeNode object.
The number of nodes in the BST must be between 1 and 100000.
The input must be a valid binary search tree.

postconditions.expression: all(node.val == original_values[node] + sum_larger_values(node, root) for node in inorder_traversal(root))
postconditions.description: Each node's value must be updated to the sum of its original value and all larger values in the BST.
The modified BST must still be a valid binary search tree.
The number of nodes in the modified BST must be the same as the original BST.
